data.name: Lutfon
data.gender_notes: Lutfon is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'lutf', meaning 'to bestow grace'. This name symbolizes kindness and grace. The name Lutfon carries the meaning “Graceful, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lutfon usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that reflects the gentle and compassionate nature of Allah (swt), and inspires the bearer to be kind and compassionate towards others.
data.etymology: Lutfon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lutfon total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_urdu.name: لطفون
